svg.text: First learning test, ignition re-check: KC cascades only on rewarded cues (diagnostic)
Each point is one 1 s test trial (5 seeds x 5 trials per cue). Red crosses: ignited trials (> 1% of non-stimulated KCs above 0.5 Hz; the sweep's definition).
Main condition: Δ = 154.49 Hz, 159.25 Hz without ignited trials; pre-stated threshold 3σ = 6.54 Hz (unchanged). Descriptive only; the verdict stands. Source:
